title: Project Configuration
description: Long-lived technical and data ownership boundaries within the data mesh. Each project is owned by exactly one team. The 'roles' property is the authoritative source for which roles are created for this project. All references use keys (e.g., 'development', 'source') not codes.

team.description: The team key that owns this project

code.description: Short code identifier for the project, used in naming conventions

alias.description: Alternative name or abbreviation for the project

oneOf.description: Wildcard to include all enabled environments
Environment keys this project is deployed to (e.g., 'development', 'production')
Wildcard to include all enabled layers
Layer keys for schemas in this project (e.g., 'source', 'staging', 'mart')
Wildcard to include all enabled compute profiles
Compute profile keys assigned to this project (e.g., 'default', 'ingest', 'transform')
Wildcard to include all enabled project-level roles
Role keys assigned to this project (e.g., 'analyst', 'engineer'). This is the authoritative source for role creation - only roles listed here (plus mandatory roles) will be created.
